models.purpose: Identify typical cooperation structures from directed passing network via hierarchical clustering and PCA
models.summary: Constructs directed ball flow network from passing events. Extracts cooperation structures (continuous passes > 5) with 6D feature vectors. Uses average-linkage hierarchical clustering and PCA (2 components, 95% variance) to identify six named cooperation patterns: Winger Machine Gun, Sidewalk Tiger, Defensive Shield, Absolute Suppress, Midfield Overall Planning, Backfield Location Adjustment.

steps: Build directed graph from passing events (nodes=players, arcs=passes, weight=count)
Extract cooperation structures with passes > 5 (1345 valid accesses)
Compute 6D feature vector per structure: x-bar, y-bar, avg distance, passes, passers, avg time
Apply average-linkage hierarchical clustering with Euclidean distance
Reduce to 2D via PCA with 95% variance retention
Identify and name six cooperation structure types
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Hierarchical clustering dendrogram cut at K=6

assumptions: Continuous passes > 5 threshold captures meaningful cooperation
Seven abnormal accesses removed due to field change timing
models.computational_cost: High: O(m^2 log m) for hierarchical clustering on 1345 accesses

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: All features computed directly from passing event data; clustering is deterministic given distance metric.

missing_details: Exact dendrogram cut height not specified
objectives: Classify team passing patterns into interpretable cooperation types

parameter_estimation.method: Hierarchical clustering (no free parameters beyond K)

strengths: Creative naming of six structures with tactical interpretation
validation_refs: Match-level case studies (Game 30 win, Game 9 defeat)

models.purpose: Evaluate team performance dynamics over match timeline using sliding window on network indicators
models.summary: Defines a 900-second (15-minute) sliding window that traverses match timeline. At each position, constructs the passing network within the window and computes two graph metrics: average node connectivity (via Edmonds-Karp max flow) and transitivity (triangles/triads ratio). Captures highlight performance periods and real-time match state.

steps: Initialize directed graph from first 900 seconds of passing events
Slide window forward: add new event at front, remove expired event at rear
At each step compute average node connectivity via Edmonds-Karp
At each step compute transitivity = triangles / (triangles + triads)
Plot indicator time series for both teams
Identify highlight periods where indicators exceed season average
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Exact computation at each window position; no iteration

assumptions: Network indicators are meaningful within partial-match windows
Second-half event times adjusted by adding last first-half timestamp
models.computational_cost: Moderate: Edmonds-Karp max flow at each window step
constraints: No data generated for first 900 seconds (initialization)

parameter_estimation.method: No estimation needed; window size is fixed

strengths: Captures temporal dynamics missed by whole-match aggregates
validation_refs: Match 15 (2:0 win): Huskies ANC consistently above opponent

models.purpose: Derive team-specific strategic recommendations from cooperation structure frequency analysis
models.summary: Compares cooperation structure usage frequency between Huskies and opponents (overall and during highlight periods). Identifies Huskies' strengths (Sidewalk Tiger, Defensive Shield, Midfield Overall Planning) and weaknesses (vulnerable to Absolute Suppress). Recommends counter-attack and long-ball strategy with 4-4-2 formation. Uses PageRank for squad selection.

steps: Compute structure frequency difference (Huskies minus opponents) for all 6 types
Identify field position proficiency from structure location data
Recommend formation and tactics based on structure strengths
Apply PageRank for player participation ranking and squad selection

assumptions: Structure frequency difference is meaningful indicator of team style
Highlight-period structures are more informative than full-match

equation_status.reason: Descriptive analytics model based on frequency comparison and PageRank; no novel governing equations defined.

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: All comparisons are direct frequency counts from Model 1 output.

missing_details: Exact squad selection criteria not formalized
strengths: Direct connection between structure analysis and tactical advice
validation_refs: Huskies performance against Absolute Suppress opponents: 0W 1D 3L
